content: Decision: use optimistic concurrency on dbo.Orders. Two writers updating the same order lost updates under the old last-write-wins rule; a rowversion column now rejects the stale write and the API retries once.

Pitfall: CS8602 null dereference in OrderService.GetOrderAsync when the cache misses.

# Release checklist

## Before tagging

Run the full test suite on Windows and Linux. Check that the changelog names every user-visible change and that the version in the manifest matches the tag.

## After tagging

Install from the tag on a clean machine, run setup, and confirm that recall returns a memory stored before the upgrade.

```text
spatial-memory doctor
spatial-memory status
```
